title: Green Alone, Red Together
description: Twelve agent pull requests, each green alone: saasyland.com's 145 agent PRs and the shared preview that was the real bottleneck, Lamplit Labs' measured merge queue vs require-up-to-date, Ray Amjad's factory-as-code replay ($940 to $630 per PR), Thoughtworks' one-sprint experiments, a 16-role factory, and Octopus Deploy on delivery. Plus a merge-tree rehearsal idea for your bots.
